task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock, then look up similar electronics and pick one alternative for me, reserve it, and confirm that order. After that, find Alice’s contact details and generate an invoice for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 with the SAVE15 code sent to alice@company.com for Stripe payment, then check my living room light, turn it on to 75% brightness, prepare a color change from white to warm white, and restart the light.

user_input.query: For user_123, please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1. If it’s unavailable, look up similar electronics in the category electronics, pick one alternative for me, reserve it, and confirm that order. Then find Alice’s contact details using contact_name alice, and generate an invoice for the items [{ product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1 }]—also product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1—for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 with coupon_code SAVE15, and send it to alice@company.com for payment through payment_gateway stripe using payment_method card. After that, check my living room light with light_id light_living, make sure light_state is on, set brightness to 75, prepare a color change from white to color warm_white, and restart the light.
